page.layout: One column of dictionary entries under a large Hebrew letter at the top; the entries are set as paragraphs with Hebrew headwords and Latin glosses. Running head centred above a rule; page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: כָּאן כָּאן Hîc, Huc, בְּכָאן כְּכָאן Hîc, לְכָאן מִכָּאן Hinc illinc : מִפָּאן וּמִפָּאן Hinc illinc. In sententia continuata repetitum, est Tam Quàm.
כִּבֵּד Honorare: Everrere domum, id enim ejus honor est. R.D. Jesa.14.23.

כִּבְיכוֹל Ut ita dicam; Ut ita mihi dicere liceat, Ac si possit dici; quando sc. usurpatur in irregularibus de Deo dictis; ut Jud.10.16. in Rab.Salom. Interdum simpliciter reddi potest, Nempe; Videlicet: Putà.
כְּבִינָה כִּבֵּן Peplum, Sindon, R.David Amos 6:7. 2:Sam.17. verf.28.
כַּד, כַּד Cùm, Quum, Quando, idem quod פַּאֲשֶׁר, unde etiam valet Sicut, quando aliis vocibus prefixum est, quod fit in Chaldaicis & Talmudicis.
כְּרָאִי Sufficiens, Satis est, Sufficit: Composita vox ex כ & דִּי servili.
כְּדוֹ כְּדוֹן Chald. Nunc, Hierosolymitane pro עַתָּה. Interdum & pro כֵּן, unde בָּתַר כְּדוּ, id est, אַחַר כֵּן Postea, Esth.1:1. in Targum.
כְּדִי Ut, Eò ut: ante Infinitivum, Propter. Post se habet ש cum Futuro tempore, כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתֵּן Ut det. בִּכְדִי Quatenus.
כְּדִי Chald. Quum, in Daniele frequens, ex כ & דִּי. Interdum, Sicut, ut הָא כְּדִי, in eodem Daniele.
כְּדָנָן, כְּדָנָה, כְּדֵין Sicut: ex כ & Pronomine דִּין.
כָּדוּר, כְּדוּר Sphæra, Globus. כְּדוּר הָאֵשׁ Sphæra ignis. כְּדוּרִי Globosum, Sphæricum. צוּרָה כְּדוּרִית Figura Sphærica.
כּוֹחַ Facultas, Vis, Potentia, Affectio: לֹא כּוֹחַ Impotentia: כּוֹחַ צְמִיחָה Facultas augescendi: כּוֹחַ מוֹסִיף לִגְדוֹל

page.notes: Several Hebrew headwords and the Hebrew in the first entry are only partly legible on the scan and are transcribed as best read; the top-left page number is unreadable. The running head is taken as the Hebrew letter printed at the top centre. The final entry breaks off at "Fa-"; the half word is omitted, and "cultas" is the catchword at the foot.
